errors.text_span: Оста Y е обозначена с приходи в трилиони долари
errors.evidence: The Y-axis itself is not labeled. The legend indicates that the unit 'трилиони долари' (trillion dollars) applies to the blue area chart ('B2C пазар'), while the orange line chart represents growth in percentage, which is labeled directly on the plot. Attributing the dollar unit to the entire Y-axis is incorrect.

errors.text_span: Има два запълнени стълбовидни графика, представени на графиката.
errors.evidence: The chart is not a bar chart. It is a combination of a blue area chart and an orange line chart.

errors.text_span: Той също се увеличава по оста X от 26% през 2017 до 16% през 2023.
errors.evidence: This statement has multiple errors. Firstly, the growth does not show a steady increase ('увеличава'); it fluctuates (28%, 26%, 17%, 18%, 13%, 16%). Secondly, the first data point for growth is 28% in 2018, not 26% in 2017.

errors.text_span: Виждат се стъпки на намаляване в процента на растеж: от 26% до 17% през 2018, от 17% до 18% през 2019, от 18% до 13% през 2022 година.
errors.evidence: This sentence incorrectly assigns values to years and misrepresents trends. For example, the value for 2018 is 28%, not a range from 26% to 17%. The value for 2019 is 26%. Furthermore, it describes an increase from 17% to 18% as a 'step of reduction' ('стъпки на намаляване').
This statement is redundant as the value 13% for 2022 was already mentioned in the preceding sentence. It is also incomplete as it omits other values.
